svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with an additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC, Time Sensitive Networking; NOS integration is required to activate any of it
svg.data-gnss: internal GNSS receiver for master-clock implementations; edge Grandmaster with PRTC
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G QSFP-DD SR/LR/ER/ZR/OpenZR+, up to 600 km (datasheet port table)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR/ER up to 40 km; 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER; 1G SFP SX/LX/EX
svg.data-sfp28-sharing: the four SFP28 ports are in-band port share with 100GE port 0 (datasheet)
svg.data-timing-cable: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable Types)
svg.data-antenna: an active GNSS antenna is required - 50 ohm impedance match, 5 V DC, noise figure 1.5 dB maximum, internal LNA gain 35-42 dB (HIG Installing an Antenna)
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMB, 1PPS in/out on SMB, ToD in/out on RJ45
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 62479; EN 50663

g.data-description: led-oob-left: the left lamp in the out-of-band jack's aperture, drawn green in HIG Figure 8's lower corners. THIS VOCABULARY IS NOT SOURCED FOR THIS DEVICE: HIG section 10 tables the six front-panel lamps and the two FRU lamps and gives this jack no table at all, unlike the S9510-28DC and S9311-64D guides from which the wording is borrowed. See the mgmt-jack-led-semantics gap; led-oob-right: the right lamp in the out-of-band jack's aperture. Same borrowed, unsourced vocabulary and the same gap as led-oob-left
g.title: oob

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (system timing/clock synchronization is disabled or unsynchronized), Solid Green (synchronized to an external reference: GNSS, 1PPS, PTP), Solid Amber (free-run or holdover mode). Three rows and no blink states: this table is transcribed as it stands rather than filled out from the S9510-28DC guide's longer one
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but the host CPU/BMC is not up)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (no fan modules present, or the modules are not initialized), Solid Green (all fan modules working normally), Solid Amber (one or more fan modules need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature enabled). The only blue lamp on the panel and the only row in the table that states a behaviour
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the 2x2 SFP28 quad, '4 x 1/10/25G SFP28 (In-band port share with 100GE Port 0)' in the datasheet's physical list. The vendor numbers them 0/1 to 0/4 - a port-0 subport notation rather than a run of its own - so rel-pos is 1 to 4 and index-origin is 1
g.title: port-sfp-1
